scope: Recovered diagnosis preprocessing, report-only CXR; no clinical datasets or images

sources.changes: Non-CXR clinical function bodies retained. Replaced image-dependent CXR branch by corrected report-index lookup. Explicit CXR failures; newest report-bearing 10 studies, chronological output; no image fields. Selection remains study-acquisition based, not report-completion based.

Explicit clinical/report DBs; report-only JSON, no image copying. Compatible subset names now use nonempty report presence. Existing-output protection and surfaced failures. Candidate bug fix: HOSP-only requires no linked ED row; multi-ED admissions are excluded rather than passed to an extractor that rejects them. Existing unique-ED clinical eligibility and retained-candidate order are unchanged.
Retains report provenance and time fields; unknown report times remain null; no image references. Ordinary radiology note identifiers/times preserved.
Historical ICD classifications and seeded selection retained. Copies only one OSCE/EHR JSON pair, not arbitrary case-folder files; rejects image-backed legacy JSON; no destructive moves.
Portable new-database-only adapter; optional ED import and streamed NOTE ZIP; preserves string ICD codes; no CXR/image indexing.

cxr_initializer.implementation: New prerequisite, not recovered historical SQL. Authorized metadata CSV plus study-keyed report JSON or native report TXT. Creates metadata_raw, metadata_ts2, reports, index_audit. Does not read images or create files_index/labels.
cxr_initializer.time_policy: Correct numeric HHMMSS left padding and decimal fractions. Missing/invalid times fail. Study time is not report signing/completion time. Existing legacy image index refused.

not_bundled: Earlier duplicate extractor versions and obsolete hardcoded launchers
Destructive legacy data_split.py (the batch builder already creates the four subsets)
One-off later Parquet dataset repacking code
Agent/training code already present in MedEnv
Knowledge corpus, CXR report corpus, source databases and actual benchmark manifests
Optional external-site ICD knowledge enrichment script; not required by the case-processing mainline
Image copying/refilling/counting helpers and image-derived labels; previous packaged version preserved outside the repository
reproducibility: Same clinical code is not proof of the same frozen benchmark. Exact input versions, prepared database, optional report/knowledge files, limits and selected-case manifest remain necessary.
runtime_compatibility: medenv/cli.py: reports mode does not require images or advertise grounding; vision stays available
rllm/tools/med_tool/cxr_tool.py: returns report text without dicoms/images; report-specific schema
